### Horsemen — Clinical Intake & Storage Protocols
- **Protocol A: Targeted Evening Readiness** (*Protokol A: Kesediaan Tenaga Malam Terfokus*):
  - **EN**: Take 1 capsule (500mg) with 250ml–300ml of warm water 45 to 60 minutes after dinner or prior to evening physical activity. Avoid heavy high-fat meals immediately before intake to maximize botanical absorption speed.
  - **BM**: Ambil 1 kapsul (500mg) bersama 250ml–300ml air suam 45 hingga 60 minit selepas makan malam atau sebelum aktiviti fizikal. Elakkan makanan terlalu berminyak sejurus sebelum pengambilan untuk penyerapan herba yang lebih pantas.
- **Protocol B: 20-Day Baseline Stamina Conditioning** (*Protokol B: Penjagaan Stamina Harian 20 Hari*):
  - **EN**: Take 1 capsule daily after your evening meal for 20 consecutive days (1 bottle) or 40 days (2-bottle reserve). Maintain 2.5L daily hydration across Malaysia's tropical climate.
  - **BM**: Ambil 1 kapsul setiap hari selepas makan malam selama 20 hari berturut-turut (1 botol) atau 40 hari (pakej 2 botol). Pastikan pengambilan air kosong sekurang-kurangnya 2.5 liter sehari.
- **Tropical Storage Standard (EN)**: Store below 30°C in a cool, dry cabinet away from direct Malaysian tropical sunlight and bathroom humidity. Keep cap tightly sealed after each use.
- **Piawaian Penyimpanan (BM)**: Simpan di bawah suhu 30°C di tempat kering dan sejuk, jauh daripada cahaya matahari terus dan kelembapan bilik air. Pastikan penutup botol ditutup rapat.

### Magnum Pump XR — Clinical Intake & Storage Protocols
- **Protocol A: Pre-Gym or Pre-Evening Activity Window (30–45 Mins Prior)** (*Protokol A: 30–45 Minit Sebelum Senaman atau Aktiviti Malam*):

- **Protocol B: Non-Training Day Vascular Maintenance** (*Protokol B: Penjagaan Harian Pada Hari Tanpa Senaman*):
  - **EN**: On rest days, take 1 black capsule between lunch and dinner with 250ml water to maintain continuous 30-day amino-acid and Tongkat Ali conditioning.
  - **BM**: Pada hari rehat, ambil 1 kapsul hitam di antara waktu makan tengah hari dan makan malam bersama 250ml air untuk mengekalkan tahap asid amino dan Tongkat Ali sepanjang 30 hari.
- **Tropical Storage Standard (EN)**: Store below 30°C in a dry, cool cabinet away from direct sunlight. Keep bottle tightly capped so the hygroscopic L-Citrulline and L-Arginine inside the 30 black capsules remain dry and free-flowing.
- **Piawaian Penyimpanan (BM)**: Simpan di bawah suhu 30°C di tempat kering dan sejuk. Pastikan penutup botol ditutup rapat supaya kandungan L-Citrulline dan L-Arginine di dalam 30 kapsul hitam kekal kering dan berkualiti.

## SECTION 4: PHYTOCHEMICAL & AMINO-ACID BOTANICAL MONOGRAPHS

### Malaysian Tongkat Ali Root (Eurycoma longifolia) (*Eurycoma longifolia Jack*)
- **English URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ingredients/tongkat-ali-eurycoma-longifolia/ | **BM URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ms/ramuan-botani/tongkat-ali-eurycoma-longifolia/
- **Botanical Family**: Simaroubaceae | **Standardization**: 100:1 Hot-Water Standardized Root Extract (≥ 2.0%–2.2% Eurycomanone, Eurypeptides & Glycosaponins)
- **Origin Geography**: Primary Dipterocarp Rainforests of Peninsular Malaysia (Pahang, Perak, Terengganu) & Borneo
- **Extraction & Heritage (EN)**: Revered across Malaysia as 'Pasak Bumi' or Malaysia's national ethnobotanical treasure, Eurycoma longifolia stores its prized bioactive compounds exclusively in mature taproots aged 5 to 10+ years. Raw crushed root bark sold in unstandardized street stalls contains mostly indigestible cellulose fiber. Onyxmen utilizes a clean 100:1 aqueous extraction process that concentrates bitter quassinoids (specifically Eurycomanone), eurypeptides (4.3 kDa), and glycosaponins while screening out heavy metals (lead, mercury, arsenic, cadmium).
- **Physiological Mechanism (EN)**: Standardized Eurycoma longifolia supports adult male vitality through three complementary nutritional pathways: (1) supporting healthy endocrine balance and free vitality bio-availability, (2) moderating elevated cortisol responses caused by sleep debt and urban Kuala Lumpur work stress, and (3) supporting skeletal muscle ATP turnover during evening physical exertion.
- **Mekanisme Fisiologi (BM)**: Ekstrak piawai Eurycoma longifolia menyokong kecergasan lelaki dewasa melalui tiga laluan nutrisi utama: (1) menyokong keseimbangan tenaga dalaman semula jadi lelaki, (2) membantu mengawal kesan kelesuan akibat tekanan kerja harian dan kurang rehat, serta (3) menyokong penghasilan tenaga selular ATP semasa aktiviti fizikal waktu malam.
- **Synergy Across Onyxmen Lineup**: In Horsemen (150mg per 500mg capsule), Tongkat Ali pairs with Peruvian Black Maca and Epimedium for rapid evening readiness. In Grow XL (140mg per capsule), it forms the backbone of a 30-day morning conditioning cycle alongside Muira Puama and Saw Palmetto.

### Tribulus Terrestris & Panax Ginseng Complex (*Tribulus terrestris L. (with Panax ginseng Synergy)*)
- **English URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ingredients/tribulus-terrestris-saponins/ | **BM URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ms/ramuan-botani/tribulus-terrestris-saponin/
- **Botanical Family**: Zygophyllaceae | **Standardization**: 45%–60% Total Steroidal Furostanol Saponins (Calculated as Protodioscin)
- **Origin Geography**: Eastern Mediterranean, Balkan Highlands & Subtropical Dry Zones
- **Extraction & Heritage (EN)**: Tribulus terrestris is the signature botanical emblazoned on the front label of Onyxmen's Hammer of Thor ('Men's Health — Tribulus Terrestris — 20 Veg. Capsules'). Its potency depends entirely on its concentration of steroidal saponins—specifically protodioscin. Onyxmen sources aerial fruit extracts standardized to 60% furostanol saponins in Hammer of Thor (200mg) and 45% saponins in Magnum Pump XR (110mg), paired with aged Panax ginseng standardized to 8%–10% ginsenosides.
- **Physiological Mechanism (EN)**: Furostanol saponins (protodioscin) and Panax ginsenosides work in tandem to support androgen receptor sensitivity, nitric oxide synthase activity in vascular endothelium, and physical resistance against muscular fatigue during heavy resistance training or evening exertion.
- **Mekanisme Fisiologi (BM)**: Saponin furostanol (protodioscin) dan ginsenosida Panax ginseng bertindak bersama untuk menyokong kecergasan reseptor tenaga lelaki, aktiviti nitrik oksida pada saluran darah, serta ketahanan otot daripada cepat lesu semasa latihan bebanan atau aktiviti malam.
- **Synergy Across Onyxmen Lineup**: Hammer of Thor pairs 200mg of 60%-saponin Tribulus Terrestris with 60mg Panax Ginseng and 15mg Chelated Zinc inside a 100% vegetarian HPMC capsule. Magnum Pump XR integrates 110mg of Tribulus alongside L-Arginine HCl and L-Citrulline inside its 30 black capsules.

### Peruvian Black Maca Root (Lepidium meyenii) (*Lepidium meyenii Walp.*)
- **English URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ingredients/black-maca-lepidium-meyenii/ | **BM URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ms/ramuan-botani/maca-hitam-lepidium-meyenii/
- **Botanical Family**: Brassicaceae | **Standardization**: 10:1 Gelatinized Black & Red-Black Hypocotyl Root Extract (≥ 0.6% Macamides & Macaenes)
- **Origin Geography**: Junín Plateau & Central Andean Highlands of Peru (4,000m+ Altitude)
- **Extraction & Heritage (EN)**: Cultivated above 4,000 meters in the freezing winds and intense UV radiation of the Peruvian Andes, Lepidium meyenii (specifically the rare Black Maca phenotype) synthesizes unique lipid-alkaloid compounds known as macamides and macaenes. Because raw maca root contains dense amylose starches that can cause bloating, Onyxmen uses a low-heat extrusion gelatinization process that removes raw starch chains while concentrating active macamides at a 10:1 ratio.
- **Physiological Mechanism (EN)**: Unlike synthetic stimulants or caffeine that spike heart rate and blood pressure, Peruvian Black Maca acts as a true metabolic adaptogen. Clinical nutrition studies demonstrate that standardized macamides support physical stamina, subjective vitality drive, and cellular resilience without altering resting pulse or disrupting REM sleep.
- **Mekanisme Fisiologi (BM)**: Berbeza dengan kafein atau bahan perangsang sintetik yang melajukan degupan jantung, Maca Hitam Peru bertindak sebagai adaptogen metabolik semula jadi. Ia menyokong daya tahan fizikal, kecergasan tenaga lelaki, dan ketahanan mental tanpa menyebabkan debaran jantung atau mengganggu kualiti tidur malam.
- **Synergy Across Onyxmen Lineup**: Featured across Grow XL (110mg), Horsemen (100mg), and Hammer of Thor (100mg), Peruvian Maca bridges Malaysian Tongkat Ali with sustained Andean endurance—ideal for men who want strong evening stamina while still sleeping deeply afterwards.

### L-Arginine & L-Citrulline Nitric Oxide Precursors (*L-Arginine HCl + L-Citrulline Malate + Piper nigrum (Bioperine)*)
- **English URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ingredients/l-arginine-l-citrulline-nitric-oxide/ | **BM URL**: https://www.onyxmen.my/ms/ramuan-botani/l-arginine-l-citrulline-nitrik-oksida/
- **Botanical Family**: Endothelial Nitric Oxide Synthase (eNOS) Amino-Acid Pathway | **Standardization**: 99.5% Pure Free-Form L-Arginine HCl + 2:1 L-Citrulline Malate + 95% Piperine
- **Origin Geography**: Pharmaceutical-Grade Plant Fermentation & Standardized Piperine Bio-Catalyst
- **Extraction & Heritage (EN)**: Nitric Oxide (NO) is the primary signaling molecule responsible for relaxing smooth vascular muscle and promoting healthy blood flow during both athletic training and evening male performance. When L-Arginine is taken alone, hepatic arginase enzymes break down a portion of it during first-pass metabolism. By combining pharmaceutical-grade L-Arginine HCl with L-Citrulline Malate and 95% Piperine (Bioperine), Onyxmen achieves both rapid onset and extended-release plasma arginine elevation.
- **Physiological Mechanism (EN)**: Phase 1 (30–45 minutes): L-Arginine HCl catalyzed by Bioperine directly fuels endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) for immediate vascular warmth and readiness. Phase 2 (1–6 hours): L-Citrulline bypasses hepatic breakdown and converts steadily into endogenous L-Arginine in the kidneys, maintaining elevated nitric oxide bioavailability throughout your workout or evening.
- **Mekanisme Fisiologi (BM)**: Fasa 1 (30–45 minit): L-Arginine HCl yang dipercepatkan oleh Bioperine terus menyokong penghasilan nitrik oksida untuk kesediaan fizikal yang cepat. Fasa 2 (1–6 jam): L-Citrulline melepasi penguraian awal hati dan ditukar secara berperingkat kepada L-Arginine di dalam plasma darah, mengekalkan sokongan stamina sepanjang sesi senaman atau waktu malam.
- **Synergy Across Onyxmen Lineup**: Magnum Pump XR (30 Black Capsules) delivers our highest amino-acid load (180mg L-Arginine HCl + 140mg L-Citrulline Malate + 65mg Thai Black Ginger + 15mg Bioperine = 400mg vascular complex per 600mg black capsule), while Grow XL, Horsemen, and Hammer of Thor each include targeted L-Arginine cofactors to enhance botanical nutrient delivery.
